name: Error Handling | Demo — Payment Failure Alert
description: Started by opening its demo URL (GET /webhook/demo-payment-failure): records a payment, shows an error page and stops on purpose (Stripe Payment Failed) so the error handler alerts. Not called by any workflow; for demos only.

parameters.content:
## Error Handling | Demo — Payment Failure Alert

Shows the "Error Handler" reacting to a real failure, for demos and videos. Opening the webhook link starts a payment step that fails on purpose (the test address always answers 503). The browser gets a 502 Bad Gateway page, and the run fails at Stripe Payment Failed, so the handler rates it P1: Telegram + Slack alert, row in Sheets, page in Notion.

Activate it to record, deactivate after (while active, anyone with the link can raise a P1 alert), then clean the Notion alert page and the Sheet row.

## Simulated Payment Failure

Triggered by: Start Payment Demo (open GET /webhook/demo-payment-failure in a browser). Runs started from the editor never call the error handler, so use the link.

1. Record Stripe Payment calls a test address that always fails (503); its error output continues.
2. Show Payment Error Page answers the browser with a 502 Bad Gateway page.
3. Stripe Payment Failed stops the run with an error, and n8n hands it to "Error Handler", which sends the P1 alert.
